topics.title: Start a local board
topics.summary: Open the local studio, connect a provider, and make one small result.

steps.title: Open CanAI
steps.body: Choose New board → Local to keep a board on this computer. Search, filters, and Sort share one desktop toolbar row.
steps.alt: Start a local board: Open CanAI

steps.title: Connect a provider
steps.body: In Settings, connect your provider before generating.
steps.alt: Start a local board: Connect a provider

steps.title: Generate
steps.body: Enter a prompt, check the quote, and choose Generate.
steps.alt: Start a local board: Generate

notes: Generation needs a provider connection. You can still explore boards and edit local content without one.
Notices and error tooltips use English. Your own content can use any language.
Missing media shows an English notice. Restore the file, then retry loading.

topics.title: Make your first result
topics.summary: Use a short prompt and keep the first run easy to inspect.

steps.title: Write one idea
steps.body: Describe the subject, style, and format in the prompt bar.
steps.alt: Make your first result: Write one idea

steps.title: Review the model
steps.body: Auto selects a compatible model; open the model menu to choose another one.
steps.alt: Make your first result: Review the model

steps.title: Run and inspect
steps.body: Select Generate and wait for the result card to land on the Canvas.
steps.alt: Make your first result: Run and inspect

notes: Video jobs can take minutes. The browser stays usable while Tasks tracks progress.

topics.title: Import files and screenshots
topics.summary: Drop media onto the Canvas or paste a screenshot; originals stay local.

steps.title: Drop or paste
steps.body: Drop image or video files up to 2 GiB each on the Canvas, or paste a screenshot from the system clipboard. Larger files are rejected before upload begins.
steps.alt: Import files and screenshots: Drop or paste

steps.title: Align or arrange a selection
steps.body: Select several cards and open Arrange. Align their edges or centres, or choose Row, Column, or Grid. Columns and Gap update the preview immediately. Click outside the panel or press Escape to keep the result as one Undo step.
steps.alt: Arrange a selection: controls beside the cards, live preview, and one Undo step when the panel closes

steps.title: Download a link
steps.body: Paste one HTTPS URL to make a link card, then choose Download to save a local copy.
steps.alt: Import files and screenshots: Download a link

notes: Imported media stays in the local media library. Text pasted into a prompt remains text.
All adjustments made while Arrange is open become one Undo step when it closes. Sizes and rotations are preserved. On tablet, select several cards and choose Arrange in the selection actions.

topics.title: Use Canvas references
topics.summary: Prompt selection can become automatic references; Assistant attachments are added deliberately.

steps.title: Select items
steps.body: Select image, video, or text cards on the Canvas. The prompt bar shows the references it can send.
steps.alt: Use Canvas references: Select items

steps.title: Check the prompt
steps.body: Auto references follow the current selection. Text cards are added as context, not uploaded media.
steps.alt: Use Canvas references: Check the prompt

steps.title: Generate
steps.body: Choose Generate to send the prompt and its selected references together.
steps.alt: Use Canvas references: Generate

notes: Selecting a Canvas item alone does not attach it to Assistant chat. For Assistant, drag a card into the chat or add it from Assets. Attachments added while a question is sending stay in the composer for your next question.
Use Play or Pause below a media preview. Drag Seek to jump; Mute and Volume change its sound.

topics.title: Understand reference types
topics.summary: Models receive images, videos, GIF first frames, and text in different ways.

steps.title: Use an image
steps.body: Image references are sent when the selected model supports them.
steps.alt: Understand reference types: Use an image

steps.title: Use video or GIF
steps.body: Video references require a video-capable model; a GIF uses its first frame as an image reference.
steps.alt: Understand reference types: Use video or GIF

steps.title: Use text context
steps.body: Text cards are appended as context for image/video prompts and wrapped as context for text generation.
steps.alt: Understand reference types: Use text context

notes: The model menu shows the compatible modality. CanAI does not silently drop an unsupported reference.

topics.title: Add photos to Assistant
topics.summary: Import a photo to the Canvas, then drag it into Assistant or choose it from Assets.

steps.title: Import onto Canvas
steps.body: Drop or paste the photo on the Canvas and wait until its card appears.
steps.alt: Add photos to Assistant: Import onto Canvas

steps.title: Drag into Assistant
steps.body: Drag the saved Canvas photo card into the Assistant dock.
steps.alt: Add photos to Assistant: Drag into Assistant

steps.title: Or click an Assets thumbnail
steps.body: With Assistant open, click the pinned thumbnail in Assets to add it to the composer.
steps.alt: Add photos to Assistant: Click an Assets thumbnail

steps.title: Check the attachment
steps.body: Confirm the photo chip is visible before sending the Assistant message.
steps.alt: Add photos to Assistant: Check the attachment

notes: The original Canvas card stays in place when you attach a photo.
Selecting a Canvas item alone does not attach it; drag it into Assistant or click its Assets thumbnail.

topics.title: Manage Assistant profiles
topics.summary: Choose a profile, edit its instructions and model, and share it through the assistant library.

steps.title: Choose a profile
steps.body: Click Universal or a named assistant to enable it. Click the enabled profile again to return to Universal.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant profiles: Choose a profile

steps.title: Edit or add
steps.body: Open Manage assistants (⋯) to add, rename, duplicate, or delete a profile. Edit its instructions and model, then Save.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant profiles: Edit or add

steps.title: Import or save a file
steps.body: Use From file to import an assistant package, or Save to a file to reuse its instructions and text documents elsewhere.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant profiles: Import or save a file

notes: A profile combines instructions, one text model, and optional text documents. It does not replace the local provider connection.

topics.title: Use Assistant actions
topics.summary: Turn a suggestion into a prompt, run all suggestions, or place text on the Canvas.

steps.title: Use prompt
steps.body: Choose Use prompt to copy a suggestion into the composer for review.
steps.alt: Use Assistant actions: Use prompt

steps.title: Generate all
steps.body: Choose Generate all to run the eligible suggestions together after their quote and confirmations.
steps.alt: Use Assistant actions: Generate all

steps.title: Add to canvas
steps.body: Choose Add to canvas to place the assistant response as a text card.
steps.alt: Use Assistant actions: Add to canvas

steps.title: Adjust the panel
steps.body: Drag the top handle to resize Assistant. Use − to collapse it; click the bottom handle to open it again. Your draft and conversation stay in place.
steps.alt: Assistant height resize handle and collapsed panel handle

notes: Assistant errors and status labels use English. Chat messages and your own instructions keep their original language.

topics.title: Choose board memory
topics.summary: Board memory keeps prompt, model, and text context; it does not see every photo automatically.

steps.title: Open memory
steps.body: Use the Board memory control in Assistant to review what context is available.
steps.alt: Choose board memory: Open memory

steps.title: Toggle context
steps.body: Turn memory on or off for the chat. Attachments and chat history remain separate controls.
steps.alt: Choose board memory: Toggle context

steps.title: Attach only when needed
steps.body: Add a photo to the chat only when you want Assistant to receive that image.
steps.alt: Choose board memory: Attach only when needed

notes: Board memory is text and generation context. It is not automatic visual access to all images on the board.

topics.title: Manage Assistant chats
topics.summary: Create, rename, archive, and restore chats; choose a model from Assistant's Chat model menu.

steps.title: Open the chat list
steps.body: Use the Assistant chat list to switch between saved conversations. A sent question stays in its original chat while references are prepared.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant chats: Open the chat list

steps.title: Create or manage
steps.body: Choose New chat, then use the chat row menu to Rename or Delete it.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant chats: Create or manage

steps.title: Restore and choose a model
steps.body: Choose a model from Assistant's Chat model menu. Move a chat to Trash; restore it or delete it permanently from Trash.
steps.alt: Manage Assistant chats: Restore and choose a model

topics.title: Edit Prompt and Assistant references
topics.summary: Add, remove, and replace references in Prompt; Assistant attachments are removed and added again.

steps.title: Add references
steps.body: Attach several Canvas items or Assets; the Prompt bar labels them @1, @2, and so on.
steps.alt: Edit multiple Assistant references: Add references

steps.title: Replace in Prompt
steps.body: In Prompt, double-click a reference thumbnail and choose its replacement. In Assistant, remove the attachment and add the new item.
steps.alt: Edit Assistant references: Replace in Prompt

steps.title: Remove one
steps.body: Right-click a thumbnail to remove it from the current references; the Canvas item stays available.
steps.alt: Edit multiple Assistant references: Remove one

topics.title: Run an Assistant request
topics.summary: Assistant explains a request, quotes it, and follows your confirmation settings.

steps.title: Ask clearly
steps.body: Describe whether you want a prompt, a text card, or new media on the Canvas.
steps.alt: Run an Assistant request: Ask clearly

steps.title: Review the quote
steps.body: Send shows the estimated cost and required confirmations follow your settings.
steps.alt: Run an Assistant request: Review the quote

steps.title: Confirm the action
steps.body: An explicit request to create or edit media can start generation; a prompt-only request does not.
steps.alt: Run an Assistant request: Confirm the action

notes: Provider connections and paid calls are explicit. A model reply alone never grants a generation request.

topics.title: Use the Assets shelf
topics.summary: Keep reusable media on the current board without removing it from the Canvas.

steps.title: Pin a card
steps.body: Drag a Canvas card or a file into an empty Assets slot. The original Canvas item stays where it is.
steps.alt: Use the Assets shelf: Pin a card

steps.title: Use an asset
steps.body: Click an asset to add it to the current composer or attach it in Assistant.
steps.alt: Use the Assets shelf: Use an asset

steps.title: Unpin it
steps.body: Right-click an asset to unpin it. The Canvas item and local file remain available.
steps.alt: Use the Assets shelf: Unpin it

notes: The shelf is per board. Assets do not become a second copy of your media file.

topics.title: Keep a board tidy
topics.summary: Assets, archive, and deletion solve different jobs.

steps.title: Save for reuse
steps.body: Pin a useful card in Assets when you want it available in future prompts on this board.
steps.alt: Keep a board tidy: Save for reuse

steps.title: Archive a board
steps.body: Archive a board to hide it from the active list while keeping its data.
steps.alt: Keep a board tidy: Archive a board

steps.title: Delete a board
steps.body: Delete sends a board to Trash. Permanent deletion removes its stored data after confirmation.
steps.alt: Keep a board tidy: Delete a board

notes: Assets belong inside a board. Archive and Trash act on whole boards, not individual references.
Connection and sign-in notices use English. Board names keep their original language.
Use Play or Pause below a media preview. Drag Seek to jump; Mute and Volume change its sound.

topics.title: Restore or delete from Trash
topics.summary: Trash gives you a recovery step before permanent deletion.

steps.title: Open Trash
steps.body: Choose Trash in the board list to see deleted boards.
steps.alt: Restore or delete from Trash: Open Trash

steps.title: Restore
steps.body: Choose Restore to return a board to the active list with its local files.
steps.alt: Restore or delete from Trash: Restore

steps.title: Delete permanently
steps.body: Choose Delete permanently only when you are sure the board and its data are no longer needed.
steps.alt: Restore or delete from Trash: Delete permanently

topics.title: Use board Versions
topics.summary: Undo is quick; Versions gives you older saved board snapshots.

steps.title: Open Versions
steps.body: Open the board's Actions menu (⋮) and choose Versions to inspect saved snapshots. Near the bottom of the window, the menu opens upward; in a short window, scroll inside the menu to reach every action.
steps.alt: Use board Versions: Open Versions

steps.title: Restore a snapshot
steps.body: Choose a snapshot and confirm Restore. CanAI creates a new board from it.
steps.alt: Use board Versions: Restore a snapshot

steps.title: Continue safely
steps.body: Keep the current board open while you compare the restored copy.
steps.alt: Use board Versions: Continue safely

notes: Restoring a version never overwrites the current board. Use Undo for a single recent edit.

topics.title: Import a .canai board
topics.summary: Bring a saved board into the local app through a file you choose.

steps.title: Open Import
steps.body: On the Boards screen, choose Import.
steps.alt: Import a .canai board: Open Import

steps.title: Choose a file
steps.body: Select a .canai file from a real local path.
steps.alt: Import a .canai board: Choose a file

steps.title: Check the board
steps.body: Open the imported board and confirm its cards and media.
steps.alt: Import a .canai board: Check the board

notes: The desktop Boards screen currently imports .canai files. Use Download or a ZIP from the Canvas when you want exported content; both use a real local destination.

topics.title: Choose Together or Each
topics.summary: Image references can be combined in one run or used one at a time.

steps.title: Select image references
steps.body: Attach two or more image references in the prompt bar.
steps.alt: Choose Together or Each: Select image references

steps.title: Choose a mode
steps.body: Together sends all images to one request. Each makes one request per image.
steps.alt: Choose Together or Each: Choose a mode

steps.title: Run compatible media
steps.body: The Together/Each choice applies to image generation only; video and text use their own reference rules.
steps.alt: Choose Together or Each: Run compatible media

notes: Each can create multiple paid calls. Review the quote before confirming.

topics.title: Pick Auto or a model
topics.summary: Auto chooses a compatible catalog model; manual selection stays exactly as chosen.

steps.title: Open the model menu
steps.body: Choose Auto to let CanAI resolve a model from the media type, references, and limits.
steps.alt: Pick Auto or a model: Open the model menu

steps.title: Choose manually
steps.body: Select a catalog model when you need its specific controls or style.
steps.alt: Pick Auto or a model: Choose manually

steps.title: Check support
steps.body: Confirm the model supports your image, video, audio, or text request before running it.
steps.alt: Pick Auto or a model: Check support

notes: Unsupported references are reported instead of silently removed. GIF references use their first frame when a model accepts images.

topics.title: Review variants and cost
topics.summary: Parallel variants are separate jobs, so the quote matters.

steps.title: Set variants
steps.body: Choose a count from 1 to 4 in the prompt bar when the model allows variants.
steps.alt: Review variants and cost: Set variants

steps.title: Review the estimate
steps.body: The price badge shows the estimated total for the selected model and variants. Macro estimates also use selected text length and original image dimensions.
steps.alt: Review variants and cost: Review the estimate

steps.title: Connect deliberately
steps.body: A provider connection is required before you confirm a paid generation.
steps.alt: Review variants and cost: Connect deliberately

notes: A new attempt after a failed paid request can make another provider call. Check Tasks before retrying.

topics.title: Restore a generation setup
topics.summary: Double-click a generated image or video to reuse its prompt and references.

steps.title: Open the result
steps.body: Double-click a generated image or video card on the Canvas.
steps.alt: Restore a generation setup: Open the result

steps.title: Review the setup
steps.body: CanAI restores the saved prompt, model, and references into the composer.
steps.alt: Restore a generation setup: Review the setup

steps.title: Adjust before running
steps.body: Edit the prompt or model, review the quote, and choose Generate for a new job.
steps.alt: Restore a generation setup: Adjust before running

topics.title: Track pending jobs
topics.summary: Pending cards and Tasks keep image, video, audio, and text jobs visible.

steps.title: Watch the card
steps.body: A pending card shows the model and elapsed time while the job runs.
steps.alt: Track pending jobs: Watch the card

steps.title: Cancel safely
steps.body: Choose the card’s close button to cancel a queued or running job.
steps.alt: Track pending jobs: Cancel safely

steps.title: Open Tasks
steps.body: Reopen a board to restore its completed image, video, audio, and text jobs in Tasks, including archived results. Restoring the list does not start another generation.
steps.alt: Track pending jobs: Open Tasks

topics.title: Retry a failed job
topics.summary: Retry is explicit so a new provider call is never hidden.

steps.title: Read the error
steps.body: Open the task details and check whether the provider request was already sent. If an error points to the diagnostic log, check the original server response there.
steps.alt: Retry a failed job: Read the error

steps.title: Retry or edit
steps.body: Choose Retry to make a new call, or restore the setup and edit the prompt first.
steps.alt: Retry a failed job: Retry or edit

steps.title: Confirm the new quote
steps.body: Review the fresh estimate before confirming another paid generation.
steps.alt: Retry a failed job: Confirm the new quote

notes: A saved provider result can finish after a restart without a duplicate submission. A manual Retry is a new attempt.
Task cards, tooltips, and progress messages use English, including errors saved by an older server. Diagnostics retain the original response.

topics.title: Build a Workflow
topics.summary: Connect typed nodes in the Workflow editor; runs start from the Canvas macro controls.

steps.title: Add a node
steps.body: Drag a node from the palette into the Workflow editor, or use the keyboard menu.
steps.alt: Build a Workflow: Add a node

steps.title: Connect ports
steps.body: Connect compatible typed ports. One input keeps one active connection.
steps.alt: Build a Workflow: Connect ports

steps.title: Run from Canvas
steps.body: Save the workflow, then launch its macro slot from the Canvas. The editor itself has no Run button.
steps.alt: Build a Workflow: Run from Canvas

notes: Nodes preserve their IDs, schemas, and typed values when a workflow is saved.
Connection errors use English. Your node labels, prompts, and Macro names keep their original language.
Use Play or Pause below a media preview. Drag Seek to jump; Mute and Volume change its sound.

topics.title: Run and stop macros
topics.summary: Each macro click starts its own run; stop controls apply to that run only.

steps.title: Start a run
steps.body: Click a macro slot on the Canvas to launch a run. Click again to start another parallel run.
steps.alt: Run and stop macros: Start a run

steps.title: Stop one run
steps.body: Open Tasks, find the run, and choose Stop for that run; other runs continue.
steps.alt: Run and stop macros: Stop one run

steps.title: Edit the macro
steps.body: Right-click or press F2 to open the Workflow/Macro editor.
steps.alt: Run and stop macros: Edit the macro

shortcuts.action: Edit the selected macro or open the external editor

topics.title: Manage the Macro Library
topics.summary: Keep reusable workflows in the app-wide Macro Library; duplicate, reorder, export, or import them.

steps.title: Open Library
steps.body: Open the Macro Library to browse saved workflows and macros.
steps.alt: Manage the Macro Library: Open Library

steps.title: Duplicate or import
steps.body: Choose Duplicate to make another library item, or Import file to add a macro package. The library is shared across the app.
steps.alt: Manage the Macro Library: Duplicate or import

steps.title: Export and organize
steps.body: Use Export file for a local package, drag rows or use Alt+Arrow to reorder, and choose Share when the shared shelf is available.
steps.alt: Manage the Macro Library: Export and organize

topics.title: Crop an image
topics.summary: Crop a card in place and keep the change undoable.

steps.title: Open Crop
steps.body: Choose Crop from a selected image card’s context menu.
steps.alt: Crop an image: Open Crop

steps.title: Set the frame
steps.body: Choose a ratio or drag the crop frame, then press Enter or choose Apply.
steps.alt: Crop an image: Set the frame

steps.title: Cancel safely
steps.body: Press Esc or choose Cancel to leave the original card unchanged.
steps.alt: Crop an image: Cancel safely

notes: Crop Apply updates the image in place and remains undoable.

topics.title: Sketch a new image
topics.summary: Draw over a card and apply the drawing as a nearby copy.

steps.title: Open Sketch
steps.body: Choose Sketch from a selected image card’s context menu.
steps.alt: Sketch a new image: Open Sketch

steps.title: Draw and Apply
steps.body: Draw on the overlay, then choose Apply to create a new image beside the source.
steps.alt: Sketch a new image: Draw and Apply

steps.title: Cancel safely
steps.body: Press Esc or choose Cancel to leave the source image unchanged.
steps.alt: Sketch a new image: Cancel safely

notes: Sketch Apply creates a new image beside the source; the source stays clean.

topics.title: Use the external editor
topics.summary: F2 opens the configured editor; the first save creates a new result beside the source, and later saves update that result.

steps.title: Configure once
steps.body: Open Settings and set the external editor path, then use Test to confirm it starts.
steps.alt: Use the external editor: Configure once

steps.title: Open with F2
steps.body: Select an image and press F2, or choose External editor from its menu.
steps.alt: Use the external editor: Open with F2

steps.title: Return to CanAI
steps.body: Save in the external editor and return. The first save creates a new result beside the source; later saves update that result.
steps.alt: Use the external editor: Return to CanAI

topics.title: Compare versions and results
topics.summary: Compare images with Curtain, Switching, or Difference; compare videos with Side by side or Curtain.

steps.title: Open Compare
steps.body: Select two compatible image or video cards and choose Compare.
steps.alt: Compare versions and results: Open Compare

steps.title: Change the view
steps.body: Press Q to start a candidate set, click items to add them, then press Enter to open Compare. Images offer Curtain, Switching, or Difference; videos offer Side by side or Curtain.
steps.alt: Compare versions and results: Change the view

steps.title: Sync video
steps.body: Turn on Sync video to keep playback position aligned between the two cards.
steps.alt: Compare versions and results: Sync video

shortcuts.action: Show the original; on video, play or pause

topics.title: Trim video on the timeline
topics.summary: The timeline keeps cuts, crops, extracted audio, and frames in one place.

steps.title: Open Timeline
steps.body: Select a video and open its Timeline controls.
steps.alt: Trim video on the timeline: Open Timeline

steps.title: Trim or cut
steps.body: Press T to open the editor, then use Cut at cursor position, Remove segment under cursor, or Find cuts. Separate audio creates an audio object.
steps.alt: Trim video on the timeline: Trim or cut

steps.title: Capture or apply
steps.body: Use Enable cropping for a crop pass, Capture frame to canvas for the current frame, and Apply edits when the timeline is ready.
steps.alt: Trim video on the timeline: Capture or apply

shortcuts.action: Remove or restore the segment under the cursor

notes: Video, frame-saving, and export errors use English. Source filenames and clip names are kept as entered.
On tablet, select a video and open Clip editing. Cut, Crop, and Capture frame stay below the preview.
Drag Playback position on the single timeline to seek. Start and End trim the clip; drag a cut down to join it again.
Crop follows the video image. Move its frame or drag a corner; precise values appear beside the preview on wide screens.
More contains segment actions, captured frames, audio extraction, and Find cuts. The ? control shows editing shortcuts.
In Clip editing, More offers Delete segment or Restore segment. Join at a listed time removes a cut without hiding the video.

topics.title: Export selected results
topics.summary: Download selected cards or export grouped folders without changing board data.

steps.title: Select cards
steps.body: Select one or more image, video, audio, or text cards on the Canvas.
steps.alt: Export selected results: Select cards

steps.title: Choose a group
steps.body: Assign a marker from 1 to 999 to selected cards; enter 0 to remove a marker. Grouped export uses the selected marker.
steps.alt: Export selected results: Choose a group

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Choose Download selected or export a ZIP folder to a real local destination.
steps.alt: Export selected results: Download

notes: Export copies user content. It does not publish a board or grant provider rights.
Markers are selection metadata for grouped export; 0 clears the marker.

topics.title: Navigate the Canvas quickly
topics.summary: Use pan, zoom, copy, and the Board map while you work across the Canvas and Workflow surfaces.

steps.title: Pan and zoom
steps.body: Hold Space and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button to pan. Scroll to zoom around the pointer. Use the Board map to navigate.
steps.alt: Navigate the Canvas quickly: Pan, zoom, and use the bottom-left Board map

steps.title: Fit the board or move around the board
steps.body: Shift+1 fits the Canvas. Pan or zoom to stop. The person-and-gear icon opens Board access, where managers set View or Edit permissions.
steps.alt: The people icon opens Board participants; the person-and-gear icon opens Board access

steps.title: Copy safely
steps.body: Hold Alt while dragging to copy the selected item and keep the original in place.
steps.alt: Navigate the Canvas quickly: Copy safely with Alt drag

steps.title: Undo and redo
steps.body: Use Ctrl+Z to undo your latest Canvas edit. Press Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y to redo it. Inside a text field, these shortcuts change the text instead of the board.
steps.alt: Undo with Ctrl+Z and redo with Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y

notes: The Board map stays in the bottom-left corner. Click or drag it to navigate, and collapse it when you need more room.
On narrow canvases, if the left column overlaps the prompt dock, the map sits 16 px above it.
The Board map moves your view while keeping the current selection.

topics.title: Add a custom fal.ai model
topics.summary: Link a fal.ai model, review its setup and price, run a confirmed test, then add the result to the catalog.

steps.title: Link the model
steps.body: Open Settings → fal.ai and models, paste the official model link, and choose Prepare test.
steps.alt: Add a custom fal.ai model: Link the model

steps.title: Review and test
steps.body: Check the prepared references, parameters, and estimated test price. For Krea 3 Edit, the megapixel estimate allows for the maximum output size, each reference, and the selected reasoning level. Choose Test model and confirm the paid test.
steps.alt: Add a custom fal.ai model: Review and test

steps.title: Add the result
steps.body: Wait for the test result, inspect it, then choose Add model to publish the tested model into your local catalog.
steps.alt: Add a custom fal.ai model: Add the result

notes: A changed test file recalculates the estimate. A model cannot be added until a valid result arrives.
Model discovery and test errors use English. Model names and sample prompts keep their original language.
Use Play or Pause below a media preview. Drag Seek to jump; Mute and Volume change its sound.

topics.title: Configure providers and models
topics.summary: Provider keys, catalog models, and price confirmations stay explicit.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Open Settings → fal.ai and models to see provider status and the current model catalog.
steps.alt: Configure providers and models: Open Settings

steps.title: Save a key
steps.body: Enter the key in the local settings form. CanAI stores only the provider configuration needed for requests.
steps.alt: Configure providers and models: Save a key

steps.title: Confirm new models
steps.body: Review a new model’s parameters and cost before it becomes available for generation.
steps.alt: Configure providers and models: Confirm new models

notes: Generation stays unavailable until a provider is connected. Review the estimate before confirming a request.
Connection errors use English. If the message asks for details, open Diagnostics to inspect the original server response.

topics.title: Keep the local app portable
topics.summary: Keep boards, media, and settings together under the local app folder.

steps.title: Keep the folder together
steps.body: Move or copy the whole app folder when transferring a portable installation.
steps.alt: Keep the local app portable: Keep the folder together

steps.title: Stop before backup
steps.body: Stop CanAI before copying the folder so active files finish writing.
steps.alt: Keep the local app portable: Stop before backup

steps.title: Protect your data
steps.body: Keep your provider key and board data private; do not include them in screenshots or shared backups.
steps.alt: Keep the local app portable: Protect your data

notes: A provider is contacted only when you start a request.

topics.title: Use the tablet client on a LAN
topics.summary: The tablet surface can connect to the local app on your network with deliberate access limits.
keywords: use the tablet client on a lan

steps.title: Open Tablet access
steps.body: In Settings → Tablet access, set an access code and choose Turn on access.
steps.alt: Use the tablet client on a LAN: Open Tablet access

steps.title: Open the listed address
steps.body: On the tablet, open one of the local addresses shown in Settings and enter the access code.
steps.alt: Use the tablet client on a LAN: Open the listed address

steps.title: Keep access private
steps.body: Sign out on the tablet to revoke that device’s session. Turn access off on the computer to revoke all sessions; devices must enter the code again after access is turned back on.
steps.alt: Use the tablet client on a LAN: Keep access private

notes: LAN access exposes the local app to devices on that network. It does not include This edition administration.
When Tablet access is off, tablet sign-in is blocked even at its localhost address. The desktop app remains available.

topics.title: Use tablet touch gestures
topics.summary: Select, pan, zoom, resize, and manage history with the tablet’s touch controls.

steps.title: Select and frame
steps.body: Tap an object to select it. Drag an empty area for a marquee; with a stylus, draw over an object to start one.
steps.alt: Use tablet touch gestures: Select and frame

steps.title: Pan and zoom
steps.body: Drag an empty area with one finger to move around. Pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan without changing card size.
steps.alt: Use tablet touch gestures: Pan and zoom

steps.title: Open object actions
steps.body: Double-tap a finished image or video to open it large. Hold an object for actions, including Resize; Apply saves one history step.
steps.alt: Use tablet touch gestures: Open object actions

steps.title: Use touch history
steps.body: Two fingers undo, three fingers redo or swipe down to copy and paste, and four fingers hide the interface. More contains Show all and 1:1.
steps.alt: Use tablet touch gestures: Use touch history

notes: Drag the prompt-panel handle to move it; − and + change width, ↔ resizes the edge, and Return to bottom resets it.
More offers Smaller interface and Larger interface; pinch the panels for a quick size change.
Hold two fingers to undo repeatedly, or hold three fingers to redo repeatedly. Hide the interface with four fingers and tap again to restore it.
Use Play or Pause below a media preview. Drag Seek to jump; Mute and Volume change its sound.
Clip editing keeps a large preview and one timeline. Crop values move beside the video in landscape and collapse on narrow screens.
Tap a name to visit their cursor or Follow to move with their view. A pan, pinch or zoom stops following.

topics.title: Recover after a restart
topics.summary: Resume saved work after a normal restart, or review a restored backup without repeating an uncertain paid request.

steps.title: Reopen the app
steps.body: Start CanAI again and open Tasks or the board that contained the pending card.
steps.alt: Recover after a restart: Reopen the app

steps.title: Wait for restore
steps.body: Normal restarts resume queued work and saved provider requests. After a backup restore, jobs without a verified request ID are held for review and media cleanup is paused.
steps.alt: Recover after a restart: Wait for restore

steps.title: Use Retry deliberately
steps.body: Choose Retry only after reading the task status; it starts a new provider call.
steps.alt: Recover after a restart: Use Retry deliberately

steps.title: Review a recovered backup
steps.body: Seeing Recovered data needs review? Keep a copy of the whole app folder. Compare boards and Tasks before retrying; repair missing work before resuming cleanup.
steps.alt: Recovered data warning with known requests resumed and uncertain requests held for review

notes: A cancelled job does not resume. Keep the app folder intact so saved boards and tasks remain available.
If both the main state file and its backup are unreadable, CanAI stops with a recovery message instead of replacing your data with an empty state.
Desktop and tablet errors use English. Your board names, prompts, and content keep their original language. An unfamiliar server error points to Diagnostics.
